options: To learn how the tool reports errors calmly before anything is at stake

question: Which of the 3 Rules for AI Coding (Worksheet 13b) prevents automation bias when running AI-generated code?
options: Decide what 'correct' output looks like BEFORE running the code
explanation: Rule 3 requires defining expected output beforehand so silent logic bugs don't look 'about right'.
